hero.name: Sapta Wiguna
hero.description: A freelance developer, game builder, and media creator. I build web architectures, mobile apps, and digital experiences backed by core logic, rapid adaptation, and a lifelong love for pop culture.

about.title: About Me
paragraphs: Hi, I’m Sapta, a graduate of Informatics Engineering Education from Universitas Pendidikan Ganesha (Undiksha), where I completed my degree on time in 8 semesters with a 3.90 GPA.

I have a deep curiosity for learning new things, and my strongest natural aptitude lies in technology—specifically anything related to computers, software engineering, and digital systems. While my formal academic background combines technology with pedagogy, my primary passion has always been on the pure IT and engineering side. Having been fascinated by computers, gaming, and how digital ecosystems work since childhood, building software and exploring new tech stacks feels like second nature to me.

Nowadays, I continue to actively learn and explore new technologies. My educational background serves as a unique bonus, allowing me to communicate complex technical logic clearly, write structured documentation, and collaborate effectively with both technical teams and end users.

I have a deep curiosity for learning new things, and my strongest natural aptitude lies in technology—specifically anything related to computers, software engineering, and digital systems. While my formal academic background combines technology with pedagogy, my primary passion has always been on the pure IT and engineering side. Having been fascinated by computers, gaming, and how digital ecosystems work since childhood, building software and exploring new tech stacks feels like second nature to me.

Nowadays, I continue to actively learn and explore new technologies. My educational background serves as a unique bonus, allowing me to communicate complex technical logic clearly, write structured documentation, and collaborate effectively with both technical teams and end users.

chapters.label: Personal Interest
chapters.headline: What Keeps Me Inspired
paragraphs: I am driven by a deep love for pop culture, from video games and music to cinema. Growing up immersed in these worlds taught me more than just appreciation for storytelling; it showed me how interactive mechanics, pacing, and algorithms keep people engaged.

Because I spend a lot of time exploring the broader international internet, I naturally stay on top of the latest updates, tech shifts, and creative trends. Having a broad mental library of references helps me see patterns everywhere, making it feel like everything is connected. While some consider gaming or watching films a distraction, I genuinely believe they are among the most enjoyable and effective ways to gain knowledge, build intuition, and fuel creativity.

chapters.label: Life Journeys
chapters.headline: How It All Started
paragraphs: My journey has been shaped by curiosity, persistence, and a willingness to dive into new experiences. Throughout my school years, I consistently ranked among the top three students in my class while actively participating in numerous competitions. Even though I rarely took home the trophy, stepping into those arenas taught me something far more valuable: how to think under pressure, learn from failure, and stay resilient when tackling unfamiliar problems.

My fascination with technology started back in elementary school, where I taught myself how to navigate the web, explore PC games, and experiment with game modding. By junior high, I was writing my first lines of code, and by high school, I had moved on to building functional web and mobile applications.
